executive_summary.conclusion: Tamil University's English site is publicly reachable and exposes clear institutional, contact and current-news facts, but the primary Admission page still foregrounds 2020-21/2021-22 materials while the homepage advertises 2026-27 admissions. The rendered audit found a usable contact route, but stale admissions guidance and one visible contact-email mismatch can make high-intent visitor questions harder to resolve; no assistant citation rate was measured.

not_checked: Actual provider assistant answers/citations, provider IP access, Search Console settings and behavioral analytics were not measured.
Keyboard-only traversal, mobile breakpoints, visible focus and form submission were not exercised.
The browser supported background rendered inspection; visible IAB presentation was unavailable in the paired subagent context.
Some linked PDFs and the external application handoff were not opened; no form was submitted.

findings.title: Primary Admission page is materially stale against current 2026-27 notices

evidence.observation: Rendered /admission/ lists PG, B.Ed/M.Ed and Ph.D links labelled 2020-21 or 2021-22, while the rendered homepage and contact-page news list current 2026-27 B.Ed/M.Ed application and prospectus notices. The primary admission page therefore does not provide a current, coherent next step for an applicant.

suggested_action.summary: Replace or clearly archive stale admission links and make the current 2026-27 application/prospectus route the primary destination.
suggested_action.mechanism: A current, year-labelled landing page with programme, eligibility, dates, fees and one verified application handoff lets crawlers and applicants resolve the admission task without navigating obsolete PDFs.
suggested_action.verification: Open /english/admission/ in a fresh browser session and confirm that every prominent programme link is current, dated and reaches the 2026-27 instructions or an explicitly labelled archive.

findings.title: Rendered Web Master contact label does not match its mailto target

evidence.observation: On the rendered Contact Us page, the Web Master contact displays the link text 'karthickanandbabu.ab@gmail.com' but its mailto target is 'sbaskarantj@gmail.com'. This is a factual ambiguity for a visitor or answer system extracting the contact route.

suggested_action.summary: Make the displayed Web Master address and mailto target identical, and add a role-specific label.
suggested_action.mechanism: Matching visible text and link target removes entity/contact ambiguity in rendered extraction and gives visitors a reliable support handoff.
suggested_action.verification: Inspect the Web Master row in source and rendered DOM; confirm the same address appears as text and mailto href, then activate the link only as a non-submitting check.

proactive_opportunities.title: Create a programme-first admissions hub
proactive_opportunities.rationale: The homepage exposes current 2026-27 notices but the primary admission route is legacy-oriented; a structured hub would align discovery with applicant tasks.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Use stable programme URLs with year, eligibility, deadline, fee and application-format fields so each answer element is extractable and cross-linked from news notices.
proactive_opportunities.verification: For a neutral query about 2026-27 B.Ed/M.Ed admissions, verify that the hub and current notice expose the same dates and next-step URL.

readiness.detail: The supplied English landing page and sampled first-party pages returned successfully over HTTPS; robots policy was collected, but real provider crawler access was not verified.
Static source and rendered DOM both exposed institutional description, navigation, current notices and contact facts; one rendered contact value conflicts with its mailto target.
Institution identity, location and contact are answerable; admission recency and current application guidance are only partial because the primary Admission page is stale.

Bounded retrieval found official first-party pages and independent government/UGC-related references for Tamil University, Thanjavur; this is retrieval evidence, not an assistant citation measurement.
Rendered landing, Admission and Contact pages supported two safe journeys; the admissions journey encountered stale content, while contact reached role-specific details without submission.
